scope: Technical evidence for the Google Play Data safety form, not a legal compliance certification. Read-only source/artifact audit; no Console changes or Assets edits.

app.title: Alien Pet: Escape Puzzle
app.source_note: The built artifact includes uncommitted authorized changes; HEAD alone does not identify the complete built tree.

sdk_inventory.name: Firebase Installations
sdk_inventory.version: transitive; not independently pinned in app template

recommended_form_summary_for_current_bui.encryption_basis: Firebase documents HTTPS; Analytics and Mobile Ads document TLS. No custom runtime HTTP/client/upload endpoint found in app-owned services/runtime. This was not a packet-capture audit of every ad creative.
recommended_form_summary_for_current_bui.account_creation_basis: No account/login UI, Firebase Auth SDK, custom user account identifier or authentication flow found.
recommended_form_summary_for_current_bui.deletion_form_answer: No verified in-app or public data-deletion request mechanism. Do not claim that requests are available until the owner supplies a real published endpoint and an actionable process.
recommended_form_summary_for_current_bui.final_submission_status: Historical artifact-1 audit. Superseded for the replacement build by privacy-implementation.json. Verify Analytics sharing/settings and privacy/deletion facts before submitting.

data_type_table.examples: IP-derived coarse location in Analytics and Mobile Ads; country code in Remote Config. No GPS access is required for this collection.
data_type_table.required_basis: No all-user opt-out. Analytics is explicitly enabled on startup; UMP regional options do not establish a global collection choice.
data_type_table.purpose_detail: Ads purposes follow the Mobile Ads disclosure; Analytics measures usage; Remote Config uses country for configuration targeting.
data_type_table.deletion: No verified app data-deletion flow; backend retention and request handling need owner/dashboard confirmation.

data_type_table.examples: Sessions, launches, screen interactions, ad taps and views. Custom puzzle outcomes and progression are separately mapped to Other actions.
data_type_table.required_basis: Analytics starts automatically; core gameplay generates events without an analytics opt-out.
data_type_table.purpose_detail: App and ad interactions measure usage and monetization. Sharing is established by Mobile Ads, without assuming every Firebase transfer is sharing.
data_type_table.deletion: No verified app data-deletion flow. Local progress reset is not deletion of server-side Analytics/ad data.

data_type_table.examples: Mobile Ads performance diagnostics, including startup, hangs and energy use; app-owned ad-load/failure analytics.
collectors: Firebase Analytics for app-owned ad-failure events
data_type_table.required_basis: No globally available diagnostic-collection choice; ads can load automatically where eligible. Choosing not to watch a rewarded ad does not disable all SDK data collection.
data_type_table.deletion: No verified deletion-request mechanism in the app. Do not equate this type with an installed Crashlytics SDK.

data_type_table.examples: Analytics app-instance ID, Android advertising ID, Mobile Ads app-set ID, Firebase installation ID. Event-specific attempt GUID is not itself a user ID.
data_type_table.required_basis: Android can restrict/reset/delete AAID, but that does not disable all identifiers. FID/app-instance collection has no global app opt-out.
data_type_table.purpose_detail: FID supports Remote Config installation identity; Analytics metrics and Ads use their identifiers. No app-owned account-management purpose is evidenced.
data_type_table.deletion: Android ad-ID controls affect that identifier, not all game/SDK records. No app-exposed FID/Analytics deletion implementation found.

data_type_table.examples: Custom level starts/outcomes/duration, retries, progression, ability choices and virtual-economy game actions.
data_type_table.required_basis: In artifact 1, app-owned Analytics was enabled automatically with no opt-out.
data_type_table.sharing_status: Not established from code. Verify GA data-sharing, Ads links and exports. The existence of AdMob alone does not prove that this custom game event payload is shared.
data_type_table.deletion: No verified request workflow in artifact 1.
data_type_table.mapping_note: Google Play explicitly lists gameplay under Other actions, distinct from App interactions.

types_not_evidenced_in_current_build.reason: No location permission or app geolocation call found. Approximate IP location still applies.

types_not_evidenced_in_current_build.type: Name, email, address, phone and app account User IDs
types_not_evidenced_in_current_build.reason: No identity input/login/custom SetUserId found. Conditional Google Signals/account-related SDK collection is a dashboard unknown, so do not give a blanket no-identifiers statement.

types_not_evidenced_in_current_build.type: Financial info / payment details / purchase history
types_not_evidenced_in_current_build.reason: No live billing provider or BILLING permission. COgheEntitlements.Store is null in the store build; virtual Drops exchanges and ad revenue are not user card details. Re-audit before enabling real IAP.
No Crashlytics SDK or app crash upload found. Mobile Ads Diagnostics remains disclosed; generic diagnostic documentation does not by itself prove a separate crash-log payload.

types_not_evidenced_in_current_build.type: Contacts, messages, photos, video, audio, files/documents, health/fitness, calendar, browsing history, user-generated content
types_not_evidenced_in_current_build.reason: No corresponding input/upload/network feature or sensitive permission found in this app. Game choices are predefined actions, not user chat/content.

local_data_and_identity.local_storage: PlayerPrefs holds progress, tutorial flags, preferences, inventory, virtual currency, energy, attempt counts and cached Remote Config. This is not an app-owned cloud-save system.
local_data_and_identity.linkage: Gameplay events can be associated with SDK app/device identifiers; no login does not make Analytics anonymous or remove disclosure obligations.

privacy_controls_and_unknowns: COgheGoogleServices.cs:51 explicitly enables Analytics immediately after dependencies resolve. No app-owned analytics consent or opt-out and no SetConsent call was found.
UMP Update uses default ConsentRequestParameters (line 73). Ads initialization checks CanRequestAds (line 108). Privacy choices is exposed only when UMP reports Required, in COgheProductUI.View.cs.

UMP 4.0 can propagate Analytics Consent Mode when configured in AdMob. That dashboard setting was not inspected by this audit. Do not claim that UMP can never affect Analytics; current code does not explicitly coordinate it. Firebase/UMP initialization is asynchronous.
Existing native test documentation reports UMP error 3 / no consent form configured. Dashboard readiness and regional consent behavior need verification before release.
No published privacy URL or actionable data-deletion process was verified here. Owner contact, retention, deletion identification and exception handling must be supplied and implemented truthfully.

Google Analytics Google Signals, data-sharing settings, linked ad accounts/audience exports and actual retention settings were not inspected. They may add data handling beyond this source-derived table.
AdMob mediation/server-side account configuration was not inspected. No additional network mediation adapter dependency was found in the app template.

No age gate, child-directed tag, under-age tag or max-ad-content-rating configuration was found in app-owned services. A separate Families/target-audience audit is required because the stated intended audience includes children.

The current official Mobile Ads disclosure page names version 25.5.0; this artifact packages native 25.4.0. The four documented categories are the evidence-backed baseline, not proof that a newer page exhaustively certifies every older SDK behavior.
No packet interception, production server retention audit or backend deletion test was performed. This audit did not change code, data collection or user-facing disclosures.

manifest_observations.note: SMS/dial/calendar intent queries in SDK manifests are visibility declarations, not SMS/contact/calendar read permissions and not evidence that the game collects those data types.

GMA_DISCLOSURE.use: Automatic Ads data categories, purposes, TLS and AAID controls; page currently names 25.5.0.

GA_DISCLOSURE.use: Analytics automatic and conditional collection; TLS; dashboard features needing review.

FIREBASE_DISCLOSURE.use: HTTPS, Firebase installations and Remote Config data handling.

PLAY_DEFINITIONS.use: SDK and pseudonymous collection are included; optional requires all-user choice; service-provider sharing exception and ephemeral definition.

UMP_CONSENT_MODE.use: UMP can interpret Analytics consent if dashboard prerequisites are configured; code inspection alone cannot establish that state.
